tools.name: list_rooms
tools.description: List every Roomie room with its on/off state, current activity, visible-activity count, and the Indigo device ids linked to it, plus controller reachability. Served from the plugin's poll cache; pass refresh=true to fetch live first. Start here to learn room names before calling other roomie_* tools.

refresh.description: Fetch live from the controller before answering instead of using the poll cache (a few seconds old at most).

tools.name: get_room
tools.description: Full detail for one room: visible activities with which one is running, toggle activities with their '(On)'/'(Off)' variants, off-type activities, and the Indigo room and activity devices linked to it. Use it to pick an activity for roomie_start_activity and to confirm state after a write.

room.description: Room name (case-insensitive; a unique partial name works), room UUID, or the Indigo device id of the room's device.

refresh.description: Fetch live from the controller before answering instead of using the poll cache (a few seconds old at most).

tools.name: get_capabilities
tools.description: Ask Roomie which remote buttons work for a room's currently running activity, grouped by category, with the device each button drives. Live call to the controller. Fails with a conflict when the room is off unless 'activity' names a specific activity to evaluate instead. Use before roomie_press_button when unsure a button is supported.

room.description: Room name (case-insensitive; a unique partial name works), room UUID, or the Indigo device id of the room's device.

activity.description: Optional: evaluate this activity (name or UUID, within the room) instead of the one currently running.

tools.name: list_devices
tools.description: Roomie's hardware inventory (TVs, receivers, streamers, switchers) with brand, model, type, room, and network address. By default only devices with a network address are returned; include_all=true adds everything Roomie knows, including devices imported from Indigo via HomeKit. Live call.

room.description: Optional: only devices in this room (name, UUID, or Indigo room-device id).

include_all.description: Include devices without a network address (HomeKit/Indigo imports, sensors, lights).

tools.name: get_status
tools.description: Plugin and controller health: configured host and port, whether the controller is reachable, consecutive poll failures and current backoff, last successful poll time, cache sizes, and Indigo device counts. test_connection=true performs a live request to the controller and reports the outcome. Use it when other tools report the controller unreachable.

test_connection.description: Also make a live request to the controller and report ok/error.

tools.name: start_activity
tools.description: Start a Roomie activity in a room, exactly like tapping it in the Roomie app. Toggle activities take toggle_state on|off (or use their '(On)'/'(Off)' name). An activity that is already running is re-dispatched and reported with was_already_running=true. Returns immediately; Indigo device states converge within a few seconds, so confirm with roomie_get_room.

room.description: Room name (case-insensitive; a unique partial name works), room UUID, or the Indigo device id of the room's device.

activity.description: Activity name (case-insensitive; a unique partial name works) or activity UUID, resolved within this room only because names repeat across rooms. Toggle activities may be named with their '(On)' / '(Off)' suffix.

toggle_state.description: For toggle activities: which side to run.

delay_seconds.description: Optional delay before Roomie runs the activity. Roomie requires at least 1.0 second; omit for none.

tools.name: power_off_room
tools.description: Power a room off using Roomie's own off resolution for that room (the 'ActivityOff' press). Powering off a room that is already off is a no-op reported with was_already_off=true, not an error. Confirm with roomie_get_room.

room.description: Room name (case-insensitive; a unique partial name works), room UUID, or the Indigo device id of the room's device.

tools.name: press_button
tools.description: Send a symbolic remote button to a room; Roomie resolves it against the room's current activity and dispatches to the right device (volume to the receiver, transport to the player, and so on). count (1-25) fires that many back-to-back taps, e.g. relative volume. digits tunes a channel and applies to the Channel button only. hold_ms (1-10000) holds the button and auto-releases, e.g. a long volume ramp. activity resolves the button against another of the room's activities. Fails with a conflict when the room is off (nothing to control) or when the current activity has no binding for the button; roomie_get_capabilities shows what is supported.

room.description: Room name (case-insensitive; a unique partial name works), room UUID, or the Indigo device id of the room's device.

button.description: Roomie Universal Remote button name (lexicon version 1).

count.description: Back-to-back taps, for relative steps such as volume.

hold_ms.description: Hold the button this long, then auto-release. Mutually exclusive with count > 1.

activity.description: Optional: resolve the button against this activity (name or UUID, within the room) instead of the running one.
